say: What tips are there for new joiners about leave?

body.answer:
For new joiners in India:
- Annual leave is credited on the last calendar day of each month.
- Your length of service is measured from your joining date to the first day of the month being credited.
- If you join after the 15th of a month, you start earning leave from the following month.
- Leave is credited in days and can include half‑days.
- You may carry forward up to 15 days of unused annual leave into the next leave year. Carried forward days do not expire on a fixed date, but your total balance cannot exceed 45 days at any time.
- Plan your leave requests early – the HR system shows how many working days will be used, and managers usually reply within a couple of days.
- Check the holiday calendar for your office early so you can plan trips and avoid overlapping public holidays.
- For any questions, you can contact HR at h***@veltrix.example.
